claimChanges.claimText: Web of Science Research Assistant is listed for University of Eastern Finland in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: institutionally licensed or procured.

UEF Primo AI Research Assistant is listed for University of Eastern Finland in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: institutionally licensed or procured.
Scopus AI is listed for University of Eastern Finland in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: institutionally licensed or procured.

Microsoft 365 Copilot Enterprise is listed for University of Eastern Finland in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: institutionally licensed or procured.

University of Eastern Finland says students may use AI to support learning and study attainments unless a teacher forbids it, but use of a generative AI application or similar in preparing study attainments must always be mentioned.

University of Eastern Finland says material containing personal data must not be exported to AI applications unless the university has an agreement covering personal-data processing, and that confidential information must not be entered into external AI applications.
University of Eastern Finland says use of AI against a teacher's instructions, or failing to report AI use, is treated as fraudulent conduct and investigated through the university's fraud process.

University of Eastern Finland states that its AI guidelines apply as a general guideline for the university's use of these services in research and teaching/studies, while faculties may provide specifying instructions within the general guidelines and legislation.

University of Eastern Finland offers Microsoft Copilot Enterprise for students over 18 via UEF login, and tells students not to use a UEF email address or university-network credential combination when logging in to external AI applications.

University of Eastern Finland says a thesis must not be completed entirely with an AI application, must include enough independent work to meet thesis learning outcomes, and AI use in a thesis must be reported in writing.
